title: Bidh-Dheng Pokak Madura - Madura Spiced Drink
ldName: Bidh-Dheng Pokak Madura - Madura Spiced Drink
ldKeywords: How to prepare traditional Indonesian drinks
Traditional Indonesian drink with spices from Madura
Indonesian spiced drink for cold weather
ldIngredientsRaw: 100 gram ginger (Indonesian: jahe), peeled and bruised
1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorn (Indonesian: biji lada hitam)
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all ingredients in a pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Turn off heat, and let steep for another 10 minutes.
Strain into serving glasses, serve hot or warm.
